data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate has applied a similar approach at the current year end to that applied at the previous year end in establishing the technical provisions for claims outstanding reserves and reinsurers' share thereof. Included within net claims incurred of GBP 473.6m (2019: GBP 302.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 7.9m (2019: deterioration of GBP 8.4m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Property, Third party liability and Accident and Health with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance to Close (RITC) from Syndicates 5820 and 1206
prior_year_events.impact_description: Assumed reserves from the 2017 years of account of Syndicates 5820 and 1206 were included in Syndicate 1861 (recorded as an RITC adjustment to opening claims provisions), resulting in significant apparent development in the 2017 underwriting year.

named_events.loss_description: Claims in respect of the Covid-19 pandemic total GBP 128m net of reinsurance recoveries, adding 27% to the net loss ratio.
Largest exposure through hurricane Laura (net incurred claims of GBP 21.5m).

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2020 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding opening balance was GBP 456.646m. During 2020 there was an overall adverse prior-year development (net) of GBP 7.9m driven by unfavourable developments primarily in Property, Third party liability and Accident & Health. The claims development disclosures and reconciliations are distorted by a significant RITC (assumption of 2017 reserves from other syndicates) which added c. GBP 63.4m of gross reserves at the opening position. Material current-year drivers included pandemic-related losses (GBP 128m net) and an active US hurricane season (notably Hurricane Laura net GBP 21.5m), contributing to reserve strengthening and higher claims activity.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 473.6m (2019: GBP 302.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 7.9m (2019: deterioration of GBP 8.4m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Property, Third party liability and Accident and Health with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.
Claims in respect of the Covid-19 pandemic total GBP 128m net of reinsurance recoveries, adding 27% to the net loss ratio.

Catastrophe experience in the year was heavier than expectation and whilst no single loss would be considered market changing on its own, there was a marked increase in the frequency of events contributing 10.7% to the net claims ratio.
hurricane Laura (net incurred claims of GBP 21.5m).

The 2018 year of account of Syndicate 1861 accepted the RITC of the 2017 years of account of Syndicate 5820 and 1206 effective 1 January 2020. The assumed reserves have been disclosed within the 2017 year of account above under "three years later" resulting in an apparent significant development in claims in respect of the 2017 YOA.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding) prior-year column. No explicit GROSS prior-year movement amount labelled 'movement in prior year's provision' was found; only a NET prior-year deterioration (GBP 7.9m) is stated and has been used (flagged). Claims development triangle is present but distorted by an RITC (assumption of 2017 reserves) which makes triangle-derived PYD unreliable. RITC gross adjustment of GBP 63.393k is recorded in the claims reconciliation and has been noted.
